purpose: Measure how many GOES M/X flares of each development year reach a positive label in the frozen development table, using two independent sources: the issued NOAA SGAS energetic-event lists (region number and peak time) joined to HARPs through the definitive JSOC NOAA_ARS association, and the frozen HEK inventory of M/X events that SWAN-SF V2 attached to no HARP. Data audit only: no relabelling, no model fitting, no threshold change.
why: The cycle-25 diagnostic found that 83% (2022) and 74% (2023) of false-alarm windows at the watch threshold come from HARPs with no positive window in the year, against 44-53% in 2014-2015, and that 2022 and 2023 hold only 16 and 38 positive runs in 12 and 27 flaring HARPs. The frozen HEK inventory lists 174 (2022) and 293 (2023) M/X events that V2 attached to no HARP, against 45 (2014) and 21 (2015). Windows containing an unassigned event are excluded, so a HARP whose flares are all unassigned keeps only negative windows and looks like a never-flaring region.
sgas_events: Section A rows of each SGAS product with an X-ray class M or X. The product issued on day D lists the events of UT day D-1; the peak is the Max column on that day. Rows without a region number are counted but cannot be mapped.
association: An SGAS event with NOAA region n peaking on date d is mapped to every HARP whose NOAA_ARS on date d contains n (definitive JSOC keyword, data/harp_noaa_mapping_20261109_r1). Events mapped to more than one HARP are counted as ambiguous and classified by their best outcome across those HARPs.

classification.covered: At least one development window of a mapped HARP has forecast_time <= peak < prediction_end and target 1.
classification.hidden: Such windows exist for the mapped HARP and all have target 0: the flare is in the data as a negative.
classification.no_window: No development window of the mapped HARP contains the peak: excluded by the fail-closed rule, removed at a fold boundary, or not observed.

hek_cross_check: An SGAS M/X event matches a HEK unassigned event when the class letter and number agree and the peak times differ by at most 5 minutes. Reported per year: HEK unassigned events, those with an SGAS match, and those whose SGAS match is mapped to a HARP.
evaluation_year_effect: For the six evaluation years, with the stored baseline probability: FP windows at the recall-0.90 watch threshold that belong to hidden HARPs (HARPs with a hidden or no_window event and no positive window in the year), their share of all FP windows, and precision and AP after removing all windows of hidden HARPs. Removal is a bound on the label effect, not a relabelling.

reading.R1_coverage_collapsed: The covered share of mapped SGAS M/X events is below 0.50 in both 2022 and 2023 and at least 0.50 in 2014 and 2015: cycle-25 labels miss most flares; a separate frozen protocol for an independent HARP association of M/X events (NOAA_ARS plus SGAS or HEK region numbers) and a walk-forward rerun on the relabelled table is justified.
reading.R2_labels_hold: The covered share is at least 0.50 in 2022 and 2023: the label pipeline is not the cause of the cycle-25 weakness.
reading.mixed: Any other pattern is reported as is.

scope: Development years only; the reserved 2024-2025 test is not read. SGAS region numbers and NOAA_ARS are themselves associations and can disagree with V2's; this audit measures agreement, not truth.
prohibitions: No new readings after seeing results
